pageProps.title: The Black Cat
pageProps.review: An honest impression of the uniquely dark and horrifying atmosphere and intense charm felt through Edgar Allan Poe's representative short story The Black Cat.
pageProps.description: I neither expect nor solicit belief for the most wild yet most homely narrative which I am about to pen
pageProps.content:
## Review This is a representative short story by the author Edgar Allan Poe, whose name I have heard many times. The first feeling I got from encountering the author's work was horror and darkness. In fact, after reading only the ```Black Cat``` part and feeling that it wasn't exactly my style, I read the rest of the short stories as well.
Indeed, it's not my style. But it has charm. I plan to challenge it again much later, in the distant future.
